data.description: Discover world-class attractions, pristine beaches, and exclusive luxury Saadiyat Island properties.

data.answer:
Saadiyat Island community offers a sophisticated lifestyle in Abu Dhabi, blending luxury living with cultural enrichment and leisure pursuits. Residents enjoy access to pristine beaches, exclusive beach clubs, and world-class golf courses, creating a serene coastal living experience.

The island's cultural district, home to the Louvre Abu Dhabi and future Guggenheim Abu Dhabi, adds a unique artistic dimension. The community also boasts high-end residential properties, including villas, townhouses, and apartments, designed with modern amenities and stunning views. With its emphasis on arts, culture, and leisure, Saadiyat Island real estate provides a refined and vibrant community for those seeking a premium lifestyle in Abu Dhabi.

Saadiyat Island comprises seven districts: Saadiyat Cultural District, Saadiyat Marina District, Saadiyat Beach, Saadiyat Promenade, Saadiyat Reserve, Saadiyat Retreat, and Saadiyat Lagoons. The waterfront community of Saadiyat Lagoon by Aldar Properties features 4 to 6-bedroom villas. There are many Saadiyat Island projects under development, including The Source II and Nobu Residences.

Saadiyat Marina District features apartment complexes like Saadiyat Noon, Soho Square, and Nasayem Complex. Soho Square offers a variety of modern residences and Park View provides hotel apartments and residential units.

Mamsha Al Saadiyat offers waterfront living with a range of luxurious apartments, penthouses, and townhouses, while Nudra by IMKAN Properties provides 6-bedroom standalone villas and residential plots. Saadiyat Grove, an upcoming mixed-use development by Aldar Properties, is set to feature living, retail, business, and leisure spaces. If you are interested in any of these projects, talk to Zoya Ventures Real Estate’s Real Estate experts. Additionally, you can search for short-term home rentals in the area or the neighboring Emirate Dubai.

Renting a Property in Saadiyat Island Abu Dhabi

Studios for rent on Saadiyat Island start from AED 39,000 per year, while 1-bedroom Saadiyat Island apartments for rent are priced at AED 52,000 minimum. Rent for 2-bedroom apartments typically begins at AED 72,000  per year, and 3-bedroom apartments are available for AED 115,000 annually. For those seeking larger accommodations, 4-bedroom apartments can be rented for AED 260,000 per year, and 5-bedroom flats start from AED 500,000.

Saadiyat Island villas for rent with 3 bedrooms begin at AED 280,000, while 4-bedroom villas are priced at AED 300,000. Larger 5-bedroom villas are available for a minimum of AED 450,000 annually, and spacious 6-bedroom villas can be rented for AED 700,000 per year. The rental price for 7-bedroom villas on Saadiyat Island is AED 1.2 million per annum.

For townhouses, 3-bedroom units can be rented for at least AED 260,000, while 4-bedroom townhouses begin at AED 309,000 annually.

Saadiyat Island Properties for Sale

For sale, studios on Saadiyat Island are available for AED 560,000, 1-bedroom apartments for AED 889,000, and 2-bedroom flats for AED 1.3 million. Saadiyat Island apartments for sale start from AED 1.65 million, while 4-bedroom flats are priced at AED 3.8 million per year. 5-bedroom penthouses can be purchased for AED 21.8 million minimum, and 6-bedroom penthouses are available for AED 21 million.

For villas, 3-bedroom units are priced at AED 2.9 million, while 4-bedroom villas start at AED 5.3 million. 5-bedroom Saadiyat Island villas cost about AED 7 million, 6-bedroom villas are available for AED 7.9 million, and 7-bedroom villas start from AED 1.7 million.

Townhouses on Saadiyat Island are also available for sale, with 2-bedroom units priced from AED 5.1 million, 3-bedroom townhouses beginning at AED 2.6 million, and 4-bedroom townhouses priced from AED 4 million.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Saadiyat Island?

data.answer:
Life on Saadiyat Island offers residents a luxurious and serene lifestyle. The island is known for its beautiful beaches, cultural attractions, and upscale residential communities. Residents can enjoy a range of leisure activities, from relaxing on the beach to playing golf at world-class courses.

The island also boasts a vibrant cultural scene, with museums, art galleries, and live performance venues. With its well-planned infrastructure and emphasis on sustainability, Saadiyat Island provides a comfortable and environmentally friendly living environment.

Public Transportation in Saadiyat Island

Saadiyat Island is served by bus routes that connect it to other parts of Abu Dhabi, making it easy for residents and visitors to travel around the city.  Additionally, shuttle services are available on the island to offer easy commutes to popular destinations.

Supermarkets in Saadiyat Island

Saadiyat Island boasts several supermarkets that cater to residents' daily needs. The Waitrose supermarket, located in the Saadiyat Beach Village, offers a wide range of products including fresh produce, groceries, and household items.

Another popular option is Spinneys, located in the Saadiyat Cultural District, which provides a convenient shopping experience with its diverse product selection and is reachable within a 10-minute drive from various residential communities.

Shopping Malls In and Near Saadiyat Island

Saadiyat Island is home to The District, a vibrant retail destination offering a mix of shopping, dining, and entertainment options. One of the closest malls is The Galleria Al Maryah Island, located approximately 15 minutes away by car. This upscale mall features luxury fashion boutiques, fine dining restaurants, and a cinema.

Another nearby option is Abu Dhabi Mall, which is about a 20-minute drive from Saadiyat Island. This large shopping center boasts a wide selection of stores, including international brands, electronics outlets, and a food court with various dining options.

Schools and Nurseries in Saadiyat Island

Saadiyat Island offers a range of educational options for families, including schools and nurseries catering to different age groups. One of the notable institutions on the island is Cranleigh Abu Dhabi, a prestigious British curriculum school offering education from pre-nursery to sixth form. The school is known for its academic excellence and wide range of extracurricular activities.

For younger children, there are several nurseries on Saadiyat Island, such as Odyssey Nursery and Redwood Montessori Nursery, providing early years education in a nurturing environment. These nurseries offer a range of programs to support children's development and prepare them for primary school.

Additionally, Saadiyat Island is in close proximity to other educational institutions in Abu Dhabi, making it convenient for families to access a variety of schooling options.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques In and Near Saadiyat Island

For Christians, St. Andrew's Church in Abu Dhabi is a popular choice, located about a 20-minute drive from Saadiyat Island. The church holds regular services and events for its congregation.

For those of the Hindu faith, the BAPS Hindu Mandir in Abu Dhabi is a prominent temple, also located approximately 20 minutes away from Saadiyat Island. The temple serves as a spiritual and cultural center for the Hindu community in the region.

As for mosques, there are several in the vicinity of Saadiyat Island, including Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, which is one of the largest mosques in the world and is located around a 25-minute drive away. The mosque is a stunning architectural masterpiece and is open to visitors of all faiths for guided tours.

Clinics and Hospitals In and Near Saadiyat Island

While Saadiyat Island itself does not have any clinics or hospitals, there are several healthcare options nearby.

One of the closest hospitals is Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi, located on Al Maryah Island, approximately 15 minutes away by car. Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi is a multispecialty hospital offering a wide range of medical services and is known for its high-quality healthcare.

For more immediate medical needs, there are several clinics and medical centers in the surrounding areas. Al Maryah Island and the nearby Al Reem Island have several clinics offering general medical services, specialist consultations, and diagnostic tests.

Saadiyat Island Abu Dhabi Location & Nearby Areas

Saadiyat Island is located northeast of downtown Abu Dhabi and is connected to the mainland by the Saadiyat Island Highway. Nearby areas include downtown Abu Dhabi to the southwest, Al Maryah Island to the south, Al Reem Island to the southeast, Yas Island to the east, and Khalifa City to the north.

These areas offer a range of amenities, including shopping malls, restaurants, schools, healthcare facilities, and leisure attractions. Saadiyat Island's strategic location provides residents with easy access to these amenities, making it a desirable residential destination in Abu Dhabi.

more_info.question: Things To Do in Saadiyat Island Abu Dhabi

data.answer:
Saadiyat Island offers a plethora of activities and attractions for visitors and residents alike. The island is home to some of Abu Dhabi's most prestigious cultural institutions, including the Louvre Abu Dhabi and the upcoming Guggenheim Abu Dhabi, making it a hub for art enthusiasts.

The island's pristine beaches offer opportunities for relaxation and water sports, while the Saadiyat Beach Golf Club provides a scenic backdrop for a round of golf. Nature lovers can explore the island's mangrove forests and wildlife, while those seeking luxury experiences can indulge in the island's high-end hotels, spas, and dining establishments. With its blend of culture, nature, and leisure options, Saadiyat Island offers a diverse range of activities to suit every taste.

Saadiyat Island Restaurants & Bars

One of the island's highlights is White, a beachfront restaurant at Jumeirah at Saadiyat Island Resort, known for its Mediterranean cuisine and stunning sea views, reachable within 10 minutes by car from most parts of the island.

For those craving Asian flavors, Sontaya at The St. Regis Saadiyat Island Resort offers Southeast Asian cuisine in a beautiful setting, just a 15-minute drive from White.

Meanwhile, Buddha-Bar Beach Abu Dhabi, located at The St. Regis Saadiyat Island Resort, offers a unique dining experience with its fusion of Asian flavors and lively ambiance, also within a 15-minute drive from White.

To experience traditional Arabic cuisine, Mezlai at Emirates Palace, around a 20-minute drive from White, offers an authentic Emirati dining experience.

For a more casual setting, the Saadiyat Beach Club's Safina restaurant, serving Mediterranean cuisine, and De La Costa, offering Spanish flavors, are both within a 10-minute drive from White.

Beaches Near Saadiyat Island Abu Dhabi

Saadiyat Island is renowned for its pristine beaches, which offer a tranquil escape and stunning views of the Arabian Gulf. One of the most popular beaches on the island is Saadiyat Public Beach, known for its soft white sand and crystal-clear waters. The beach is ideal for swimming, sunbathing, and picnicking, with facilities such as showers, changing rooms, and sun loungers available for visitors.

For those looking for a more exclusive experience, the private beaches of the island's luxury resorts, such as the St. Regis Saadiyat Island Resort and the Park Hyatt Abu Dhabi Hotel and Villas, offer a luxurious setting with amenities such as beachside dining and water sports activities.

Hotels in Saadiyat Island

Saadiyat Island is home to several luxurious hotels that cater to both leisure and business travelers, offering a range of amenities and stunning views of the Arabian Gulf. The St. Regis Saadiyat Island Resort is a popular choice, known for its elegant accommodations, fine dining restaurants, and the region's first Iridium Spa.

The Park Hyatt Abu Dhabi Hotel and Villas is another top pick, offering spacious rooms and suites, a private beach, and several dining options. For those looking for a more intimate setting, the Saadiyat Beach Club offers boutique hotel rooms with access to its exclusive beach and facilities. Other notable hotels on Saadiyat Island include the Jumeirah at Saadiyat Island Resort, offering contemporary luxury and beachfront dining, and the Rixos Premium Saadiyat Island, known for its all-inclusive packages and family-friendly amenities.

Attractions and Landmarks in Saadiyat Island Abu Dhabi

Saadiyat Island is renowned for its cultural attractions and natural beauty, offering a range of landmarks and sites to explore. One of the most prominent attractions is the Louvre Abu Dhabi, an architectural masterpiece that houses a stunning collection of artworks spanning centuries and cultures. The museum's unique design, featuring a massive dome that appears to float above the galleries, is a sight to behold.

Another cultural landmark on Saadiyat Island is the upcoming Guggenheim Abu Dhabi, designed by architect Frank Gehry. Once completed, the museum will showcase a diverse collection of modern and contemporary art, further enhancing the island's reputation as a cultural hub.

For nature enthusiasts, the Saadiyat Beach Golf Club offers a picturesque setting for a round of golf, with stunning views of the Arabian Gulf. The club's 18-hole championship course is designed to blend seamlessly with the island's natural landscape, creating a unique and challenging golfing experience.

Saadiyat Island is also home to the Manarat Al Saadiyat, an arts and culture center that hosts exhibitions, workshops, and events celebrating Emirati heritage and contemporary art. The center provides insight into the island's rich cultural heritage and its role in shaping Abu Dhabi's cultural landscape.

One disadvantage of living on Saadiyat Island is the limited public transportation options within the island itself. While the island is well-connected to the mainland and other parts of Abu Dhabi by road, residents can use their personal vehicles or taxis for commutes.

What are the top island communities in the UAE?

The UAE boasts several top island communities renowned for their luxurious lifestyle, stunning landscapes, and exclusive amenities. Palm Jumeirah in Dubai is one of the world's most iconic man-made islands, featuring upscale residential villas, apartments, hotels, and resorts, along with a plethora of dining, shopping, and entertainment options.

Similarly, Saadiyat Island, Yas Island, and Al Reem Island in Abu Dhabi offer a blend of entertainment and leisure with attractions, alongside residential communities and luxury hotels. Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah is known for its beautiful beaches and waterfront living, offering a mix of residential, hospitality, and leisure developments.

Is Saadiyat Island open to the public?

Yes, Saadiyat Island is open to the public, and visitors can access various attractions, beaches, and cultural sites on the island. However, some areas, such as the private beaches of luxury resorts, may have restricted access for non-residents.

What are the major attractions on Saadiyat Island?

Some of the major attractions on Saadiyat Island include the Louvre Abu Dhabi, Saadiyat Beach Golf Club, Manarat Al Saadiyat, and the upcoming Guggenheim Abu Dhabi. These attractions showcase the island's rich cultural heritage and offer a range of experiences for visitors.

Are there residential communities on Saadiyat Island?

Yes, Saadiyat Island is home to several residential communities offering a range of housing options, including apartments, villas, and townhouses. These communities provide residents with access to a range of amenities and recreational facilities.

How do I get to Saadiyat Island?

Saadiyat Island is accessible by road from Abu Dhabi city. Visitors can take the Saadiyat Island Highway, which connects the island to the mainland. The island is also accessible by taxi or private car, and there are parking facilities available for those driving to the island.

data.content:
Saadiyat Island houses exquisite resorts, upscale residential communities, and world-class cultural attractions. Spanned about 27 sq. km, Saadiyat Island is divided into seven districts. Located just 600 meters from the main city, it connects to the mainland via Sheikh Khalifa Bridge.

You can enjoy a luxurious stay at Saadiyat Island’s resorts or immerse yourself in world-class art and history at the Louvre Abu Dhabi. Beyond its cultural appeal, Saadiyat Island boasts pristine beaches, including Saadiyat Public Beach, and leisure options such as the Saadiyat Beach Golf Club, which offers a stunning course with panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf.

Saadiyat Island is one of the most sought-after areas for off-plan developments in Abu Dhabi, particularly for luxury apartments and villas.

nodes.title: The Arthouse
nodes.about:
Art House, situated on Saadiyat Island in Abu Dhabi, seamlessly combines modern design with cultural richness. This exclusive residential project, currently under construction, offers premium 1, 2, 2-plus, and 3 bedroom apartments, including 2 luxurious sky villas.

Inspired by private members’ clubs worldwide, Art House provides like-minded residents with purposefully designed spaces that stimulate creativity and connection. The development features rich architectural details and multifaceted interiors crafted by the award-winning DiLeonardo, making it a "gallery for living" for those with a discerning taste for arts and culture. Unique spaces like an art studio, gallery, and creative rooftop majlis form the vibrant community's core, fostering collaboration and co-creation in Abu Dhabi’s most coveted neighborhood.

Developed by Aldar Properties, ART HOUSE Abu Dhabi is the first residential development in Saadiyat Cultural District to boast a stunning rooftop setting with pools and a garden. Residents can enjoy breathtaking views of architectural masterpieces and the turquoise waters of the Arabian Gulf. Aldar's dedication to sustainable living is evidenced by ART HOUSE’s 3 Pearl Estidama rating and its aim for a 2-star Fitwel certification.
